## Task 1026

Hoagie Haven's web application has been launched and we're getting orders! But we're getting fewer orders than we were expecting... We want to verify that the system is working as expected.

Given the following product requirements for the Hoagie Haven menu page, verify that all are met. For any that are unmet, create a pull request that brings the product back into alignment with the requirements.

## Product Requirements

- The menu page should be accessible by clicking "Start an Order" from Hoagie Haven's main page
- The menu page should display all sandwiches available for order from Hoagie Haven
  - Hoagie Haven currently offers 4 sandwiches
- Each sandwich should include the following:
  - Name
  - Description
  - Image
  - A Call To Action button to add the sandwich to the order.
- The Hoagie Haven main page is accessible by clicking on the Hoagie Haven logo.
- When the menu is first loaded, there is no link to the cart.
- Clicking on the button to add the first sandwich to the order creates a cart button including the number of items in the cart.
- Adding subsequent items to the order increments the cart count.
- Clicking on the cart button loads the cart page.

## Deliverable

- Please include a GitHub pull request as described in the project README.
- The PR should include a description of the unmet requirement and a description of how the change meets the requirement

## Hint

There is exactly one unmet requirement.
